text: When they told him, Hazrat Yaqub said the same words he had said all those years ago.
"Rather, your souls have enticed you to something. So patience is most fitting."
But this time he added: "Perhaps Allah will bring them to me all together."
He turned away and said: "Oh, my sorrow over Yusuf." His grief was so deep that his eyes turned white. And still, he held it in.
His sons told him to stop, before grief destroyed him. And he answered with one of the most beautiful lines in the Quran.
"I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah. And I know from Allah that which you do not know."
Then he told them: "O my sons, go and find out about Yusuf and his brother. And despair not of relief from Allah."
After all these years... he still had not given up.
